name: Low altitude: too low to descend, so the RA is a turn
description: Ownship is level 700 ft above a field at 5,400 ft. Traffic is head-on and 150 ft higher, so the altitude-first choice is to descend. Below 1,000 ft above the ground a descend RA is not allowed, and climbing would cross the other aircraft's altitude, so this is the one case where the RA is a turn. The pilot does not respond and the simulated autopilot flies it.
